judgement_items: Does the `preconditions` field of a service manifest carry a claim about what the operation enforces, or only a description of its logical shape? If it carries a claim, eight console operations are misdeclared today and console.discover-operations misinforms every fresh operator that asks. If it does not, the local_node_record declaration this commit adds to console.revoke repaired nothing. Both readings cannot stand, and the answer sets whether the missing declared-versus-enforced check is a contracts-domain gap or a console defect.

Is a manifest `note` a governed claim held to the same evidence standard as the fields beside it? Three consecutive commits have now written a count or a quotation into this note that the file itself defeats, and no check in the repository reads the note at all.
